description: The old Entra record is deleted only in the instance's group names.bicep names, never in a group taken from elsewhere (ADR-0063, ADR-0052).

patches.find:
instance_rg="$(prov_name "$names" entraResourceGroup)"
  entra_name="$(prov_name "$names" entraDeployment)"
  az deployment group show
patches.replace:
instance_rg="$(jq -r '.group' "$plan/entra-group.json")"
  entra_name="$(prov_name "$names" entraDeployment)"
  az deployment group show
